mentions.name: Colombian Digital Euro (CBDC) specification adaptation
mentions.description: This project ports and adapts the Digital Euro (CBDC) specifications for Colombia, intended to complement Bre-B, the country's instant payment system modeled after Brazil's Pix. Once finished, it will be submitted for review to BanRep, Colombia's central bank.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am porting/adapting the Digital Euro (CBDC) specifications for Colombia to complement Bre-B (our instant payment system modeled after Pix). I plan to submit it for review to BanRep (our central bank) once it's finished.
